name: camphor (synthetic) + eucalyptus oil + menthol
uses: Uses • on chest and throat, helps temporarily relieve cough due to common cold • on joints and muscles, temporarily relives minor aches and pains
otcwarn: Stop use and ask a doctor if: • cough lasts more than 7 days, comes back, or occurs with fever, rash, or persistent headache. These could be signs of a serious conditions. • muscle aches and pain persist more than 7 days or come back

src.label: Vaporizing Chest Rub
src.maker: NINGBO LIYUAN DAILY CHEMICAL PRODUCTS CO., LTD.
